regime_detection_markov.note: Two independent papers converge on vol-conditioned Markov regime detection. 2605.27848: 3-state HMM (low/transitional/high-vol) on SPY/TLT/GLD, BIC selects 3 states, outperforms passive in 30% OOS — single split, no walk-forward. 2605.30943: conditioning on realized vol (vs returns) reduces Chapman-Kolmogorov discordance 5.6%; high-vol regimes converge to homogeneous transitions (regime persists). Combined: vol is the right conditioning variable, high-vol regimes are sticky. Directly validates H002 mechanism. Status EMERGING — 2 papers from different authors but one has methodological gaps (single split, no Sharpe reported). Third independent paper with walk-forward needed for CONSOLIDATING.
regime_detection_markov.h002_support: 2605.30943 provides statistical confirmation that vol-conditioned transitions are more stable — this is the mechanism behind H002's clamp(vol_28d/vol_5d, 0.5, 2.0)

open_hypotheses.description: Funding rate mean-reversion speed (OU theta) on HL perpetuals predicts carry quality: high theta (fast reversion) → noisy carry, reduce Strategy B position size; low theta (persistent regime) → sticky carry, hold or increase.

open_hypotheses.priority_note: Scheduled for combined IC feasibility session with H003 (W23 P2). Method: AR(1) theta = 1-phi_hat, rolling 30-day window, Spearman IC HAC lag-6.

open_hypotheses.description: Vol-ratio position scalar for Strategy A v4: position = tanh_signal × clamp(vol_28d / vol_5d, 0.5, 2.0). Scales down when near-term vol is expanding faster than medium-term baseline, reducing crash-regime exposure that caused the propfirm breach.
open_hypotheses.w23_note: 2605.30943 (Neural Markov W23) provides statistical confirmation: conditioning on realized vol reduces regime estimation error; high-vol regimes are sticky (homogeneous transitions). This is the theoretical basis for why vol_5d/vol_28d expansion correctly identifies transitional (not stable) regimes. Elevated from open to pre-registration candidate for Strategy A v4 modification #1. Cite T4 (W21) + T6/2605.30943 (W23) in pre-registration document.

open_hypotheses.conflict_with_archived: none — archived 'Macro overlay' (CLAUDE.md ✗) refers to directional alpha overlays on TSMOM (L17/L18 sentiment proxies). H003 is a risk gate (kill-switch) on delta-neutral carry, not a directional overlay.
open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Fiat turbulence (VIX-correlated) is the primary stress propagation channel (2605.30442) — precedes crypto repricing. During risk-off, institutional leveraged long demand collapses on crypto perps 12-24h before spot reprices, compressing funding rates. VIX>25 identifies onset of this sequence. Kill-switch: reduce Strategy B 50% or exit fully when VIX closes >25; re-enter when VIX <20 on close.
open_hypotheses.caveat: If N_events <10 in available data window, skip IC test and defer to 2026-10-01 (12+ months HL data). Note VIX>25 as manual monitoring threshold in the interim.

methodology_flags.description: Heavy-tailed DM test distortion (arXiv:2605.16866): conventional HAC t-stat critical values distorted when forecast error distributions have infinite variance (Lévy-stable tails). May affect Strategy A crypto IC tests. Not applicable to Strategy C (equity index futures).
